clips.title: The story
paras: Taming the Beast is the culmination of a hunter's early training in Elwynn Forest, overseen by Josephine Carson. After demonstrating mastery over boars and wolves, hunters are tasked with using a Taming Rod to pacify and gain the trust of a Young Forest Bear. This final trial deepens a hunter's attunement to beasts and maintains the woodland's natural balance through respect and skill.

Aspiring hunters in Elwynn Forest undergo rigorous training to understand the wild creatures sharing their lands. Having already demonstrated command over the cunning wolf and the hardy boar, hunters face a final test of courage and patience. Josephine Carson directs them to confront the Young Forest Bear, the burliest and mightiest of the forest's common predators. This rite tests whether a hunter can withstand the bear's raw strength and earn its trust rather than simply subjugating it.

The lesson behind taming Elwynn's wildlife is rooted in respect rather than dominion. Forest bears represent the brawn and vitality of the woodland, playing a vital role in maintaining the natural order. By using a specially prepared Taming Rod, hunters learn to quiet the beast's aggression and establish a genuine bond of mutual understanding. Successfully calming such a formidable animal deepens the hunter's spiritual attunement to the wild, completing their foundational lessons under Carson's guidance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.
Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go forth, friend, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, friend!
